text: Modules under src/adrcheck/domain/ must not import adrcheck.adapters.
Modules under src/adrcheck/domain/ must not import adrcheck.usecases.
Modules under src/adrcheck/domain/ must not import adrcheck.cli.
Modules under src/adrcheck/domain/ must not import subprocess, requests or httpx.
Modules under src/adrcheck/domain/ must import only the standard library and other domain modules.
quote: Modules under `src/adrcheck/domain/` import only the standard library and each other.

text: Every dependency the domain or use cases need from the outside world must be declared as a Protocol in src/adrcheck/ports.py, namely AdrSource, ChangeSource, RepoReader, ObligationCompiler and ChangeJudge.
quote: Every dependency the domain or use cases need from the outside world is a `Protocol` in `src/adrcheck/ports.py`: `AdrSource`, `ChangeSource`, `RepoReader`, `ObligationCompiler`, `ChangeJudge`.

text: The module boundary must be enforced by tests/test_boundaries.py, which fails on the first offending import.
quote: The boundary is enforced by `tests/test_boundaries.py`, which fails on the first offending import.

text: Supporting a new provider must be done by adding a new adapter, never by changing the domain.
quote: A new provider is a new adapter and never a domain change.

text: The domain must build and test without network, git or a model.
quote: The domain builds and tests with no network, no git and no model.
